# Lassie

Lassie is a Software Development company. Lassie is an AI that runs the doctor's office. It automates admin enrollments, payment posting, EFT reconciliation, and helps teams focus on patients. Lassie employs 23 people. Headquartered in San Francisco, United States. Its workforce is distributed across United States, India, and Netherlands. with 1 prior funding round.

## About

Lassie enables doctors to focus on patients, not paperwork.

The average practice spends around 200 hours a month running itself. We have seen firsthand how the administrative burden is quietly breaking independent healthcare.
 
Doctors work late into the night so that they can get through all of their paperwork by hand. Nobody taught them how to submit a claim, bill a patient, or reconcile insurance payments.

Our goal is to enable these businesses to run themselves.

Lassie works autonomously, around the clock, reading insurance claims, reconciling payments, handling denials and appeals.

Over 700 practices across 49 states trust Lassie to run their operations. In the past year alone, we have saved more than 250,000 hours of labor, time redirected entirely to patient care.

Learn more or join the team: lassie.ai

# GTM Associate at Lassie

- **Company:** Lassie
- **Location:** San Francisco, CA
- **Department:** Sales
- **Employment type:** Full Time
- **Published:** 2026-06-03

# Description

Our mission is to help small businesses run themselves. We’re starting with doctors’ offices, building autonomous systems that handle busywork and complete the workflows that keep the office moving every day. Our team is small, flat, and ambitious. We value craft, intellectual rigor, and direct communication.

**About the role**

As a GTM Associate at Lassie, you'll create the first spark of demand. You'll identify promising doctors' offices, run thoughtful outreach you'd want to receive yourself, schedule demos, and help us learn which messages actually land with small businesses.

**What you'll do**

- Build lists of promising doctors' offices and run thoughtful outreach across email, phone, social, events, and more

- Experiment with messages, segments, and channels to learn where demand is strongest

- Run early discovery conversations to understand who's working in the practice, how the office operates, and where Lassie may or may not fit

- Partner closely with Account Executives to schedule demos with offices that meet Lassie's ideal customer profile

- Keep the GTM engine organized, measured, and moving

**What we're looking for**

- You have 1–2 years of SDR or BDR experience

- You move fast, think fast, and improve with every rep

- You never give up, with a smile on your face

- You build real rapport with a busy doctor in 90 seconds, and they feel it

- You're self-aware, flag what isn't working, and know how to improve

- You're excited about helping a small business run itself

**Joining us**

To start, you'll have a handful of conversations with our team and founders. If there is mutual excitement, we'll invite you to the office where you'll work on a small project and meet the team.

# Head of Marketing 

 Reposted 10 Days Ago 

 San Francisco, CA, USA 

In-Office

Mid level

Healthtech • Software

The Role

The Founding Growth Lead will build growth strategies to scale Lassie's customer base and ARR while leveraging AI-driven tools and experimentation.

Summary Generated by Built In

Our mission is to help small businesses run themselves. We’re starting with doctors’ offices, building autonomous systems that handle busywork and complete the workflows that keep the office moving every day. Our team is small, flat, and ambitious. We value craft, intellectual rigor, and direct communication.

About the role

As Lassie's Head of Marketing, you'll be responsible for turning customer love into compounding, revenue-accountable demand. You'll connect product, data, marketing, sales, and customer insight to crack the message and build the repeatable, scalable channels that help Lassie reach far more doctors' offices efficiently.

This is a hands-on role for someone who wants to build Lassie's marketing engine from the ground up. You'll work directly with the founders, who bring deep experience building and scaling growth systems.

What you'll do

- Own Lassie's demand-generation system, with qualified demos booked as your north star and ARR and payback as guardrails
- Crack the message and positioning through customer insight, sales calls, data, and systematic experimentation
- Personally find and prove creative, predictable, and scalable growth channels
- Turn what's working into repeatable systems, then build a lean, AI-native team around them
- Own the execution of brand and product marketing in partnership with the founders

What we're looking for

- You have a demonstrated track record of finding and scaling revenue-generating growth channels
- You've worked at an early-stage startup and are comfortable personally doing the work before building a team around it
- You're a natural seller and message crafter: you can pitch a product, write copy that converts, and make an audience feel understood
- You think from first principles, generate unconventional ideas, and ship enough experiments to discover what works
- You bring rigor and numeracy: you know your metrics, can explain exactly why something worked, and can replicate it in a different context
- You already use AI tools daily to build, automate, and operate, and you're excited to rethink distribution and growth strategy from the ground up
- You're fiercely competitive and want to build a company that wins its category

Joining us

To start, you'll have a handful of conversations with our team and founders. If there is mutual excitement, we'll invite you to the office where you'll work on a small project and meet the team.

## Skills Required

- Early-stage startup experience
- Growth experience in B2B SaaS
- Software engineering skills
- Strong copywriting ability
- Ability to sell on a live demo call

The Company

 17 Employees 

## What We Do

 We're building the operating system for independent doctors. Our mission is to put their business on autopilot so they can focus on providing the best care for their patients.

_request.query:
Company: Lassie (website https://lassie.ai).
Test to verify: Actively hiring now, with at least one open go-to-market role.
How it is tested: At least one requisition listed today on the company's own careers page or ATS board with a GTM title: sales, marketing, growth, ABM, demand generation, SDR or BDR, partnerships, revenue operations.
Decide pass, fail or unclear for THIS company today, citing the freshest relevant source.
_request.systemPrompt: Today is 2026-09-10. You are verifying one qualification test for one specific company. Use only what the sources say. The most recent dated announcement of an event is the authority on the company's current state; older announcements are history; company profile pages (LinkedIn, Crunchbase, CB Insights, Tracxn) are secondary to the company's own pages and to dated news. Never confuse the company with a same-name company on a different website. Answer pass only when a source states the fact; fail only when a source contradicts the test; otherwise unclear. The evidence_quote must be copied verbatim from the cited source.

reasoning.description: One or two sentences: what the freshest relevant source says and how it decides the test.

evidence_quote.description: A verbatim sentence or fragment from the cited source that decides the verdict; empty if unclear.

evidence_url.description: The URL the quote comes from; empty if unclear.

evidence_date.description: The date of that source as shown on it (YYYY-MM-DD if known); empty if unknown.
